product_overview: A production-ready React starter template with authentication, an admin dashboard, user management, and a reusable UI component library to accelerate SPA development. It provides pre-configured routing, forms, validation, and API integration for rapid developer onboarding.
core_goals: Provide a complete, pre-configured React starter to remove repetitive setup
Enforce modern patterns (TypeScript, hooks, TanStack Query) and developer ergonomics
Offer built-in authentication and protected admin routes with JWT token management
Include a modular admin dashboard with user and role management (CRUD)
Ship a reusable Radix/Tailwind-based component library and theming system

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to sign in with email and password. Client-side validation is enforced and a successful login attaches a JWT token (cookie) and redirects to the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click "Sign in" button to submit -> Redirect to /admin/dashboard -> See dashboard overview
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with invalid format -> Fill password input field -> Click "Sign in" button to submit -> See validation error message for email
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field with incorrect credentials -> Click "Sign in" button to submit -> See authentication error toast or inline error message

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new user account via a registration form with name, email, username, password and confirmation and client-side validation. Successful registration issues a token and directs the user into the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill username field -> Fill password field -> Fill password confirmation field matching password -> Click "Create account" button -> Redirect to /admin/dashboard -> See dashboard overview

Navigate to /register -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Fill password confirmation field that does not match password -> Click "Create account" button -> See validation error message for password confirmation
Navigate to /register -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Leave terms acceptance unchecked -> Click "Create account" button -> See validation error message for terms acceptance

features.name: User Management (Admin)
features.description: Admin users can list, create, update and delete users from the admin user management screen. Operations use TanStack Query hooks and API endpoints for CRUD operations.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> AuthGuard allows access -> See user list
Navigate to /admin/users -> See user list -> Click "Add User" button -> Fill user form fields (name, email, username, role, status, password if creating) -> Click submit -> See new user in user list
Navigate to /admin/users -> Click user row / Edit action -> Update required fields -> Click submit -> See updated user details in list
Navigate to /admin/users -> See user list -> Click delete/archive action for a user -> Confirm deletion -> See user removed from list
Navigate to /admin/users -> Click "Add User" button -> Fill email field with invalid format -> Click submit -> See validation error message for email

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Protected admin dashboard providing an overview and navigation to admin features (users, roles). Access is guarded by AuthGuard which redirects unauthenticated visitors to the login page.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> AuthGuard allows access -> See dashboard overview and statistics
Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> Use sidebar navigation to click link to /admin/users -> Navigate to /admin/users
Navigate to /admin/dashboard without authentication -> AuthGuard checks -> Redirect to /login -> See login page

features.name: Public Home & Navigation
features.description: Public-facing landing and informational pages (home, features, pricing, agenda, about, contact) with links to authentication pages for guest users.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See landing page hero section -> Click Login link in navbar -> Navigate to /login
Navigate to /features -> See features content
Navigate to /non-existent-route -> See 404 Not Found page

features.name: Theming (Dark/Light Mode)
features.description: Client-side theme toggle using next-themes. Theme preference is persisted and affects CSS variables across the app.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Theme Toggle -> Observe UI switches to dark mode -> Click Theme Toggle again -> Observe UI switches to light mode
Navigate to / -> Click Theme Toggle -> Reload the page -> See previously selected theme persisted
Navigate to / -> Click Theme Toggle -> Reload the page when persistence fails (e.g., cookies/storage blocked) -> See theme revert to default (persistence failure observed)
